{{recipe}}

[[Cookbook:Pumpkin|Pumpkins]] are unavailable most of the time in some countries. An excellent substitute for all uses is made from the following:

==Ingredients==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Kilogram|kg]] (about 2 [[Cookbook:Pound|lbs]]) mixed [[Cookbook:Carrot|carrot]] and [[Cookbook:Swede|swede]]
* 500 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] (about 1 lb) plain [[Cookbook:Yogurt|yogurt]]

==Procedure==
#[[Cookbook:Puréeing|Purée]] the vegetable mix until smooth.
#Add the yogurt.
#Use in place of pumpkin purée.

==Notes, tips, and variations==
* Frozen carrot and swede mix makes this a very easy substitution.
* Purée thoroughly to obtain a smooth mixture.
* The ingredients can be added whole to foods that will be puréed later.
* Other winter squashes may also be used as substitutes for pumpkin
